hints.title: Alternate Across Indices
hints.text: Iterate index i from 0 up to max(len(word1), len(word2)).

hints.title: Append if Within Bounds
hints.text: If i is within word1 bounds append word1[i], then if i is within word2 bounds append word2[i].

hints.title: Combine Characters
hints.text: Join the resulting characters into the merged output string.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear merging is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear scan merges both strings in O(n + m) time and O(n + m) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate writes a clean single loop or two-pointer alternation.
